# BTicino C300X Integration v2.6.0

## Unreleased

Display-page settings put Status, Energy, Agenda and Leave home first, followed
by up to seven custom pages. Page headings show the configured display positions;
the existing order on the device is unchanged.

Energy's Today chart shows grid export below zero without cancelling grid
import or solar production. Hourly readouts include the negative values.
Consumers displays whole watts; rankings and bar lengths retain measurement
precision.

Setup, reconfiguration and connection options validate credentials before
saving. Rejected agent or supplied maintenance keys have distinct errors from
an unreachable device. Home Assistant can request reauthentication for the
existing entry without replacing its identity or unrelated settings. Existing
entries retain offline startup and recovery; one-time SSH installation remains
separate. Repeated event registration failures produce one outage warning and
one recovery message instead of repeated warnings.

The doorstation card has one media window for live video, saved HA snapshots
and saved HA capture videos. **Browse saved images and videos** is on by default
(`show_media_history: true`); previous/next browses media chronologically
inline, without a separate visitor list or modal. Saved videos have play/pause,
a seek timeline, volume/mute and fullscreen where supported, with their
recording timestamp at the lower right. Snapshots retain their configured
date/time stamp. Live video and incoming rings take priority; browsing never
starts, answers or stops a device call. Home Call, door/light buttons, card
name, status and existing enable options remain available.

Automatic images still use the device-wide **Save images** switch, on rings
and HA video streams, with the configured delay (3 seconds by default) and
retention (14 days by default). No open card is needed, and no image files
are written to the C300X. History does not automatically record clips: configure
the bundled **C300X Ring capture** blueprint or a capture service automation
separately. The blueprint includes audio by default, which answers the Ring Call;
choose video only when it should not answer.

Media stays in existing HA storage, with per-device snapshot directories and
device-specific indexing of newly completed default-path ring and on-demand
captures. Arbitrary historic MP4s are not automatically imported, and the
C300X's built-in answering-machine recordings are not included. Set
`show_media_history: false` to hide history on one card without stopping image
saving or recording automations. History retention removes links, not MP4s;
clip storage remains separately managed. See
[Media history](../../docs/visitor-journal.md) for setup and access details.
